name: Cat Queen
description:
👑 Cat Queen (CATQ) — the royal cat of the Base Chain.
She doesn’t need a king — just loyal soldiers who play, stake, and earn for the glory of her kingdom.

Every holder is part of the royal army.
Every spin, every game, every staking reward… all for the Queen.

🐾 Meow the Base. Rule the Chain.
#CatQueen #CATQ #MeowToEarn
